Thanks Marcus, jumping in. High level response and proposed next steps below. I've attached a first-pass diagram (draft_network_diagram_v1.png) and a short answer sheet (redwood_ans_sheet_v1.docx) we can use to fill their questionnaire.

Short answers (can expand in call):
- Private / VPC: fully supported. We can deploy a customer-isolated data plane inside your VPC or peered dedicated VPC. Control plane can be either Redwood-managed (recommended for faster upgrades) or customer-managed in Private deployments.
- KMS / Keys: BYOK supported via customer KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM). We can integrate with your KMS for encryption at rest and manage TLS for in-transit with mutual TLS where required.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation (note: redact date until NDA executed). We will provide the report through our security/Intel team under NDA.
- GDPR: We support region pinning and data residency controls for EU data; DPA available.
- HIPAA: If needed, we can scope a BAA and work with your compliance team — additional controls and validation required.
- Air-gapped / on-prem: feasible but a professional services engagement. Typical timeline: 8–12 weeks initial deployment + integration for air-gapped installs; includes onsite eng time, packaging, and validation.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-min architecture deep-dive (Monica + SRE + Marcus + Acme infra/security) — propose Tue 2026-07-13 10:00am PT.
2) I'll share an updated deployment diagram showing: VPC peering options, ingress/egress controls, KV/KMS placement, log export/SIEM integration, and fallback model (hosted -> dedicated -> private).
3) We'll fill the questionnaire and return a redlined copy within 3 business days after the call.
4) Naomi to provide a rough commercial delta for Private/Dedicated options in parallel.

Attachments: draft_network_diagram_v1.png (PNG), redwood_ans_sheet_v1.docx (DOCX - answer sheet)

If that plan looks good I'll book the deep-dive and send calendar invites.
